title: Decision Table — How Long an Arrangement Runs on Belrose Promotional Financing Plans
content:
# Decision Table — How Long an Arrangement Runs on Belrose Promotional Financing Plans

The months an arrangement on a Belrose Promotional Financing Plan runs for are read in one of three ways.

| The plan at the handling date | The months the arrangement runs for |
|---|---|
| Stands past due | **Twice** the term's hardship length, twice being a multiple of **2** |
| Has been billing for at least the term's promotional length less the term's hardship length | To the end of the promotional term, that is the term's promotional length less the whole calendar months the plan has been billing, and never fewer than one month |
| Any other case | The term's hardship length |

A past due plan takes twice the hardship length however far through the promotional term it has run.

## Figures by term

| Term | Promotional length, whole months | Hardship length, whole months | Twice the hardship length, whole months |
|---|---|---|---|
| 6-Month Deferred Interest Plan | 6 | 3 | 6 |
| 12-Month Deferred Interest Plan | 12 | 3 | 6 |
| 18-Month Deferred Interest Plan | 18 | 6 | 12 |
| 24-Month Equal Payment Plan | 24 | 6 | 12 |
| 36-Month Equal Payment Plan | 36 | 6 | 12 |
| 48-Month Bridal Equal Payment Plan | 48 | 12 | 24 |

## Readings (hypothetical)

A plan on the 24-Month Equal Payment Plan, whose promotional length is 24 whole months and whose hardship length is 6:

| The plan | The months the arrangement runs for |
|---|---|
| Past due after 10 whole months of billing | Twice 6, that is 12 |
| Active after 20 whole months of billing | 20 is at least 24 less 6, so the arrangement runs 24 less 20, that is 4 |
| Active after 24 whole months of billing | The promotional length less the months billed would fall below one, so the arrangement runs 1 month |
| Active after 10 whole months of billing | 10 is below 24 less 6, so the arrangement runs the term's hardship length of 6 |
